# `bill_allocation`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

An amount applied to a customer bill (ours; TMF678 appliedPayment, TMF676 paymentItem): from a payment or from the credit of a negative bill, automatic (oldest open bill first) or explicit. Append-only. Bounds: per paid bill <= its amount due, per payment <= its amount, per credit note <= minus its amount due (deferred constraint trigger).
